name: Akaruku Tanoshii Saimin Gakuen ~Ero Kousoku o Ippai Tsukuttara Chou Riajuu ni Nareta!~
original_name: 明るく楽しい催眠学園～エロ校則をいっぱい作ったら超リア充になれた!～
source:
Bad at study and bad at sports with no desire to get better, school was a meaningless drudge for the protagonist until one day he gained an ability that redefined school life itself.
 
He instituted new regulations that made his brutal fantasies into reality. A new school life with nude attendance, where menses are announced and sex can happen anywhere......

The power of hypnosis makes anything possible.
School is bright and fun, at last!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE122638.html]DLsite English[/url]]
